name: OPC
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: The OPC token contract on BSC was exploited on April 1, 2025 for approximately $107K. No detailed public post-mortem has been published for this incident. The specific vulnerability in the contract has not been publicly disclosed. Attack Tx: 0x65a29faf44c5be567e9ea2aa419254263a1b8553799258d9e36769a06ceac109
